name.zh: 学生会室骚动与奥多摩巨人任务
name.en: Student Council Chaos and the Okutama Giant Mission

periods.summary: Ikki and Stella help Toka carry papers, discover the chaotic student council room, and are invited to help investigate reports of a four-meter giant near Hagun's Okutama training facility.
periods.cause: Kurono asks the student council to confirm whether the training camp area is safe before Seven Stars representative camp, but the student council lacks manpower.
periods.process: Kanata explains the sighting; Renren and Stella bond over unidentified creatures; Ikki agrees to help because the facility exists for students and he benefited from the selection system.
periods.outcome: Ikki, Stella and the student council schedule a weekend trip to Okutama.
periods.significance: Introduces the student council dynamic and sets up the Akatsuki-related Okutama attack.
